record.question: What is the approximate radiation dose threshold below which significant fetal harm (e.g., malformations) is generally not observed, and termination of pregnancy is not typically recommended based on radiation exposure alone?
record.explanation: Answer B: 50 mGy.. Radiation-protection guidance commonly uses about 50 mGy as the level below which deterministic fetal effects are not expected and termination is not generally recommended solely on exposure grounds. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
